title: Secrets and Vars on the env Object
description: Two lines that read a secret and a plain var from the env object, using the same syntax for different storage.

steps.description: Inside the handler, both secrets and vars arrive on the `env` object. You read them with the same syntax.
`env.UPSTREAM_API_KEY` is a secret. It came from `wrangler secret put` and never sits in a file.
`env.MODEL_NAME` is a plain var. It came from `wrangler.toml`, which is committed to the repository.
